name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began tinkering with engines in his grandfather's garage in rural France. He quickly developed a knack for understanding the intricate workings of racing machines. After graduating from engineering school, he started as a junior mechanic, steadily climbing the ranks through dedication and a sharp eye for detail. He honed his skills as a race engineer before transitioning into management. 

As team principal, Jean-Pierre fosters a collaborative environment, believing in empowering his team and valuing their input. He is a firm believer in data-driven decisions, but also understands the importance of intuition and the human element in racing. His ambition is to build Sprint V8 into a championship-winning team, brick by brick, focusing on long-term sustainable success.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a serious demeanor reflected in his sharp features and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on personally inspecting the cars before every race.
Has a lucky vintage racing cap he wears under his headset.
